text:
mariam: Hey team — weekend poll! I'm torn between two low-key plans: (A) volunteer shift at HappyTails rescue Saturday morning + we run a tiny bake sale afterwards (cookies/lemon bars), or (B) sunset stargaze at Windward Hill with my little reflector telescope (clear skies forecast). Who's up for A, B, or both? Reply with emoji :dog: for rescue, :star2: for stargaze, :cookie: for both.
josh: Rescue sounds good. I can do the morning shift. I’ll bring folding table if needed. :dog: 
tara: I’m allergic to dogs so rescue is out for me, but I’ll join stargaze if someone brings hot chocolate. Also can bring a thermos. :star2: ☕
luis: I can make lemon bars and help lug gear — have a tiny Dobsonian that’s fun to set up. If we do both, I can swing rescue noon-ish and stargaze after sunset. :cookie:
mariam: Yay lemon bars! Quick logistics — rescue shift is 9–12 at the vet clinic, then bake sale 12:30–2pm. Windward Hill meetup ~7pm for sunset. Weather link: https://forecast.example/clear?loc=windward (looks mostly clear)
sasha: I’ve got a delayed flight but might be able to pop by rescue for an hour around 11. If not, I’ll bring blankets for stargaze. :dog: / :star2:
ops-bot: Reminder — company matches volunteer hours. Submit time on the Contrib portal to claim the stipend.
josh: Quick poll — react here: :dog: rescue+bake, :star2: stargaze, :cookie: both. I voted :dog: already.
mariam: Also, if anyone has a telescope eyepiece to spare, bring it. If we have more scopes we can do a little target list: Jupiter, Saturn (if up), and a double star near Vega.
tara: Count me in for thermos duty and stargaze checklist prep. Also can bring a small Bluetooth speaker for ambient tunes. :star2:
luis: I’ll print a tiny sign for the bake sale that says "Proceeds to HappyTails" — printing in office Tuesday. Anyone want to split shopping for baking supplies?
sasha: I’ll grab napkins and disposable cups if I end up at the bake sale. If someone saves a lemon bar, I will pay in crypto. 
mariam: Cool — looks like mixed votes but rescue gets the most interest right now. Plan: confirm rescue crew by Friday noon; stargaze is contingency if folks want to come after. Vote final in thread please.
josh: Sounds perfect. Thanks for organizing, Mariam! :thumbsup:
